`final class UIDataDebugObject`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataDebugObject.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataDebugObject.java)

The dev-mode options of `@UIDataDebug` for a running UI.

## Description

[`UI.getDebug`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-getDebug) returns it.
Each option has a getter and a setter of the same name, such as `hotreload()` and `hotreload(boolean)`.

### profiler

- `this profiler(boolean profiler)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `boolean profiler()` 

**Default:** `true`

If `true`, dev mode prints the load time of the UI and warns about slow frames.

<a id="UIDataDebugObject-property-hotreload"></a>

### hotreload

- `this hotreload(boolean hotreload)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `boolean hotreload()` 

**Default:** `true`

If `true`, dev mode reloads the UI when its classes change.
